response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and software development expertise with a focus on testability and user experience, but his background lacks direct experience in hardware optimization, SoC/IP modeling, or AI accelerator performance analysis—key requirements for the Principal Performance Architect role. His work with DLang, low-latency systems, and open-source projects shows technical depth, though alignment with the role's core responsibilities is limited.
strengths: Extensive experience with low-latency systems and performance-critical applications (e.g., micro-services at Sociomantic, real-time note-taking tools).
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership, including workshops and tooling (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts).
Diverse technical stack exposure (DLang, Node.js, TypeScript, Kubernetes) with a focus on scalability and infrastructure.
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, or deep-learning workload analysis—core to the role.
Background is primarily software-focused (full-stack, web, mobile) with limited hardware or cloud infrastructure expertise.
Lacks advanced degrees (PhD/Master's) or equivalent professional experience in hardware/performance architecture.
